title: Full Hotel Intelligence Investigation

paragraphs: Cambridge Beaches Resort & Spa (Sandys Parish / Somerset, Bermuda) is Dealality Golden Demo #2 — a private Bermuda ownership archetype distinct from listed-company PropCo filings.

Economic sponsorship sits with Dovetail + Co following the April 2021 acquisition from Frascati Hotel Company. Public Bermuda materials identify Cambridge Beaches Holdings Limited (incorporated 22 January 2021) as both property owner (ministerial statement) and hotel developer (Tourism Investment Order 2022).

Current day-to-day operation is assessed as Dovetail self-operation / stewardship (PROBABLE): hotel site, careers, footer, and GM LinkedIn show no third-party manager. Benchmark’s May 2021 operating announcement is treated temporally; Pyramid/Benchmark still show residual portfolio/media listings that prevent a HIGH-confidence finding that every commercial association has ended.
Brand is Independent — Cambridge Beaches (not Beaches Resorts / Sandals). Product: ~86 suites on a best-supported 23-acre private peninsula (20-acre conflict disclosed on tourism listings).

Redevelopment is framed by the Tourism Investment Order 2022 (customs/occupancy/payroll/land-tax relief windows) with announced cottage/F&B/spa/public-area/tennis/pool/grounds scope. Material completed investment is evidenced; full certified completion remains open.
Financing: Butterfield Bank is confirmed as lender (CEO quote + bank social confirmation). Amounts and charges are not public. Argus Group is mentioned as a historic partner — role ambiguous.

Decision paths: Phil Hospod (Dovetail Founder & CEO) for sponsor control; Cambridge Beaches Holdings Limited for Bermuda legal/developer path; Clarence Hofheins (GM since 2012, retained through ownership change) for property path. Karla Bruning appears in 2025 journalism as co-owner narrative — not deed-verified.

Open priorities: Bermuda registry directors/UBO, deed instrument, formal operator-agreement termination, Butterfield quantum, Tourism Investment opening certification, and residual Pyramid listing meaning.

key_findings.explanation: Hotel first-party surfaces show Dovetail stewardship and no third-party manager; Pyramid residual listings prevent HIGH certainty of total dissociation.

key_findings.headline: Brand is Independent — not Beaches Resorts
key_findings.explanation: Standalone Cambridge Beaches product under Dovetail stewardship.

key_findings.headline: Butterfield Bank confirmed as lender
key_findings.explanation: CEO quote and bank social confirmation; amount undisclosed.
